payout_quote: Listing items was completely free, and everything was insured. ... From the previous fees (25% lender commission + 25% borrower fee), we changed to the Hygglo model of 20%+10%. That means we lowered the total combined fees by approximately 40%.
steps: Create a Hygglo account (Fat Llama accounts carried over automatically; same platform, new name since 24 Nov 2025).
List items you own (cameras, tools, bikes, event gear, electronics) with photos, a daily rental price, and your location - listing is free.
Verify your identity and bank details so payouts can reach you.
Approve incoming rental requests, arrange handover with the borrower, and document item condition.
Get paid for each rental with the 20% lender commission deducted; the borrower pays a separate 10% fee (25% for high-risk categories like cameras).
catches: Hygglo takes a 20% lender commission on every rental (borrowers pay a separate 10% fee, 25% on high-risk categories such as cameras) - under the old Fat Llama model the split was 25%/25%.

Coverage is capped, not unlimited: general items up to GBP 3,000, film & photo up to GBP 10,000, vehicles (trailers) up to GBP 30,000 - and amounts/caps vary by market; high-value items are not fully protected.

Earnings are fully demand-driven: you set daily prices but income depends on item desirability, local demand, and density of renters nearby; 'over a million rentals' is platform volume, not your earnings.
Items suffer wear, damage, loss, and late returns - deposits are not automatically required and resolution goes through the platform's guarantee process.
Available only in 7 countries (UK, Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Finland, US, Canada); US coverage is thinner than the UK/Nordic core.
Rental income is taxable; ID and bank verification required before payouts.
biggest_catch: Hygglo keeps 20% of every rental you make and insurance caps out at GBP 3,000 for general items, so lending expensive gear still carries real loss risk - and earnings depend entirely on local demand for your specific items.
eligibility: 18+, ID verification and bank details for payouts; must own the items you list. Service available in UK, Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Finland, US, Canada.
timing: Listing is free and self-serve; rentals booked on demand. Payout per completed rental with 20% commission deducted. First rental depends on local demand and item appeal.
weasel_words: lowered the total combined fees by approximately 40%
